dailyLog.meals: Morning: tea with milk no sugar, 3 slices Inked Bread, 240 ml Pressed orange+beet juice. Labels photographed and read.
dailyLog.symptoms: Slight cramp in both calves. Bilateral, at rest, the day after wearing a 20 lb vest for about an hour.
dailyLog.carbsEstimateMethod: All from labels or his own measurements: 3 slices Inked Bread = 3 g net (33 g total, 30 g fibre); 240 ml Pressed orange+beet juice = 25 g; tea, 200 ml with 30 ml milk = 1.5 g. Nothing estimated.
